entries.note: First-ever DARK-THEME capture of the Claude desktop Code page in any dated set (2026-07-13 and 2026-07-20 mac-app-code entries are all light theme). Full window incl. traffic-light title bar: split two-pane session view (main session left: file edits, alignment-grid table, terminal, tasks panel; second session right: 'Migrate API client' with its own composer), 'Auto accept edits' composer footer, model label 'Opus 4.6', card-on-card panel stacking (Preview/diff/terminal/tasks as separate dark cards over the base session pane), orange accent color unchanged from light theme. Real official-video pixels of the current redesigned Code UI, not a marketing mockup -- fills the mac-app dark-theme gap from the 2026-07-28 health check for the Code page. Home page dark theme is still NOT covered by any local video (this video is Code-page-only branded 'Claude Code'); that gap remains open.
entries.assetDecision: Ground-truth reference of the real application for fidelity work — recreate the surface as closely as possible from it. Logged-in captures may contain the owner's private content; keep those local and use synthetic demo content in tracked surfaces.

entries.note: Official vendor screenshot, LIGHT theme, full composer + Home greeting: '(asterisk) Back at it, Zoe', composer 'How can I help you today?' with +/sliders/history icon row, model selector reading 'Sonnet 4.5' (one generation behind current Sonnet 5 -- treat model label as directional/dated only), row of quick-action chips below composer: Code / Write / Create / From Drive / From Calendar (the Drive and Calendar connector chips are NOT yet reflected in our mac-app-home-empty-light 2026-07-20 manual-inbox capture -- worth checking against the current surface). CAVEAT: the crop includes macOS traffic-light window chrome + a sidebar-toggle icon, so this may be a stylized desktop-app rendering used for marketing rather than a pure browser-tab capture; treat window chrome as directional, trust the composer/greeting/quick-action content as real product copy and layout. This is a docs-press rung fallback, not a true live-web capture -- claude-in-chrome had zero connected browsers this session (list_connected_browsers returned []), so the higher-rung live-web capture with measured tokens.json (per reference/sources.json target 'web-app-home') is STILL not filled; that requires either a reconnected Chrome extension session or a user-provided screenshot.
